\# Removes PayTo-specific fields from Payment Methods

\## What’s new

Removes the \[payto\](https://docs.stripe.com/api/payment\_methods/update.md?api-version=2026-09-30.endive) field (containing \[account\_number\](https://docs.stripe.com/api/payment\_methods/update.md?api-version=2026-09-30.endive), \[bsb\_number\](https://docs.stripe.com/api/payment\_methods/update.md?api-version=2026-09-30.endive), and \[pay\_id\](https://docs.stripe.com/api/payment\_methods/update.md?api-version=2026-09-30.endive)) when you \[update PaymentMethods\](https://docs.stripe.com/api/payment\_methods/update.md?api-version=2026-09-30.endive). Previously, the API accepted these \[PayTo\](https://docs.stripe.com/payments/payto.md)-specific fields with a \`200\` status but never persisted the values. You can still update other fields such as \[billing\_details\](https://docs.stripe.com/api/payment\_methods/update.md?api-version=2026-09-30.endive#update\_payment\_method-billing\_details) and \[metadata\](https://docs.stripe.com/api/payment\_methods/update.md?api-version=2026-09-30.endive#update\_payment\_method-metadata) for PayTo Payment Methods.

\## Why is this a breaking change?

The \`payto\` parameter isn’t accepted when you \[update a Payment Method\](https://docs.stripe.com/api/payment\_methods/update.md?api-version=2026-09-30.endive). If your integration sends \`payto\` or any of its sub-fields (\`account\_number\`, \`bsb\_number\`, \`pay\_id\`) when updating a PayTo Payment Method, the request returns an error instead of a \`200\` status. Update your code to remove these fields from your requests.

\## Impact

If your integration passes \`payto\`, \`payto\[account\_number\]\`, \`payto\[bsb\_number\]\`, or \`payto\[pay\_id\]\` to \[update a Payment Method\](https://docs.stripe.com/api/payment\_methods/update.md?api-version=2026-09-30.endive), those requests now return an error. Remove these fields from your update calls. No previously stored data is affected because the API never persisted these values.

 \- If you don’t use an SDK, update your \[API requests\](https://docs.stripe.com/api-versions.md#how-versions-are-specified-in-requests) to include \`Stripe-Version: 2026-09-30.endive\`
